features.title: Everything your club needs
features.subtitle: Nine modules that grow with you – start small, expand anytime.
features.f1Text: Structured courses with videos, files, drip scheduling and prerequisites – for trainings, workshops and onboarding.
features.f2Text: News, announcements and discussions in one place. Likes, comments and nested replies – no more group chats.
features.f3Text: Schedule and host live sessions and assemblies – with recurring events, reminders and attendance tracking.
features.f4Text: Statutes, protocols and forms – with folder structure, versioning and granular per-group permissions.

features.f8Text: Push, email and in-app notifications for new posts, event reminders, chat mentions and course updates.
features.f9Text: Access courses, events and posts via API. Webhooks keep your systems informed about events in real time.

about.title: The story behind Coledia
about.lead: Coledia started with a simple frustration: great clubs running on spreadsheets and endless group chats – because real software was too expensive.
about.founderRole: Founder & Software Engineer – Wiesmann Solutions Engineering
about.founderText1: I'm a software developer from Switzerland. When the boxing club I was in struggled with tools that cost hundreds per month and still felt stuck in 2010, I saw the need to digitalize their operations and started building Coledia on evenings and weekends.
about.founderText2: Coledia is not a venture-funded startup with an exit plan. It's a product of Wiesmann Solutions Engineering – a one-person company. That means every decision is made with users, not investors, in mind.

timeline.title: The road so far
timeline.m1Text: First sketches after a boxing club assembly where the treasurer's Excel chaos made the need for digitalization obvious.
timeline.m2Text: A working prototype gets tested with real members – and reshaped based on what they actually need.
timeline.m3Text: Coledia enters its pilot phase – early clubs shape the product with real feedback that drives future improvements. Join now and your input directly influences what gets built next.

values.title: Why clubs shouldn't pay enterprise prices
values.v1Text: Volunteer-run organizations deserve the same modern software as corporations – at a price that fits a club treasury.
values.v2Text: Questions land directly with the person who builds Coledia. Answers within 24 hours, not weeks.
values.v3Text: Hosted with care, built to last, and respectful of your members' data – no ad-tech, no data selling.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Is Coledia really free for small clubs?
faq.a1: Yes. Clubs with up to 50 members use the Starter plan free of charge – forever, not as a trial. We grow when you grow.
faq.a2: Yes. All plans are cancellable monthly. After cancellation, your data remains exportable for 6 months – after that it is permanently deleted.
faq.a3: Coledia is a product of Wiesmann Solutions Engineering, a Swiss one-person software company. You work directly with the engineer who builds it.
faq.a4: Data is hosted in Europe with strong privacy standards. We never sell member data, and there is no third-party tracking.
faq.a5Part1: Yes, but only on request. There is documentation you can follow along with YouTube tutorials. For a custom migration you can book an appointment – it will be billed separately.
